description:
With over 14 years of dedicated experience in student counselling, I specialize in DASA (Direct Admission of Students Abroad) counselling, guiding students and parents through one of the most critical phases of their academic journey. My expertise lies in simplifying the complex admission process for premier institutions such as NITs, IIITs, and other top government-funded universities under the DASA scheme.

I have successfully mentored hundreds of NRI, OCI, and foreign national students, helping them secure admissions in top engineering colleges in India based on SAT scores. From profile evaluation and college shortlisting to choice filling strategy and final seat allotment, I provide end-to-end personalized guidance tailored to each student’s goals and academic background.

My counselling approach is transparent, data-driven, and student-centric, ensuring clarity, confidence, and optimal decision-making throughout the DASA admission process. I stay consistently updated with the latest admission policies, cut-offs, and trends to deliver accurate and result-oriented guidance.
